profile.heroBio: I am Ryan Ofori-Koree, a Computer Science student at Ashesi University building full-stack products across web and mobile, using AI-assisted tooling. From escrow platforms and academic systems to hackathon-winning MVPs, I focus on shipping useful software with clear architecture and polished user experiences.
profile.aboutBio: I am studying BSc Computer Science at Ashesi University with hands-on experience as a Platforms Developer Officer Intern at Npontu Technologies and a Software Development Intern at SnooCODE. I work with Python, Java, JavaScript, PHP (Laravel), SQL, and modern AI-assisted tooling. Recent achievements include 1st place at the Coded Esports x Miro Fashion Hackathon, 2nd place at the Obsessive Innovations Hackathon and completion of inro to CS50 Python from Harvard (edX). I am looking for opportunities to build impactful products in areas such as fintech, marketplaces, and developer tools.
